item.title: Gingerbread Crinkle Cookies (Eggless!)
item.description: These gingerbread crinkle cookies are a holiday must-try – with warm spices, molasses, and brown sugar - they’re soft and chewy inside, with a sweet, sugar crinkle crust.

item.title: Black Eyed Pea Soup (Vegan)
item.description: This vegan black eyed pea soup is a simple, healthy, and satisfying one-pot meal perfect for New Year or any day - packed with nutrients, fiber, and flavor.

item.title: Week 76 Meal Plan
item.description: This Week 76 Meal Plan will save you lots of time and money! From mini pot pies, to pasta dishes, and more, there is something to love! Try out this easy to follow Week 76 Meal Plan this week.

item.title: Lemongrass Tofu
item.description: This Vietnamese-inspired lemongrass tofu is bold, citrusy, and packed with flavor with only simple pantry ingredients – perfect with rice and noodles! Plus, it's ready in just 30 minutes!

item.title: Week 77 Meal Plan
item.description: This Week 77 Meal Plan offers free, time-saving, and delicious recipes! From soups, salads, to vegan pizza, it's the perfect plan to keep you organized this week.

item.title: Week 78 Meal Plan
item.description: This Week 78 Meal Plan has it all! Save time and money with these simple yet delicious recipes from soup, chili, tofu dishes, and more!

item.title: Week 79 Meal Plan
item.description: Try out some easy, tasty, and time-saving recipes with this Week 79 Meal Plan. You'll save tons of money at the grocery store whipping up delicious recipes like vegan tacos, pasta dishes, and stir-fries.

item.title: Strawberry Banana Muffins (Egg-Free)
item.description: Juicy strawberries, sweet bananas, and a crunchy sugar top make these moist, tender strawberry banana muffins a must-try Spring/Summer snack - no eggs needed!

item.title: Week 80 Meal Plan
item.description: This Week 80 Meal Plan will be a great guide for prepping this week! Save time and money making vegan dishes that everyone can enjoy.

item.title: Roasted Parsnips
item.description: These roasted parsnips are tender inside with caramelized, crispy edges and a nutty, earthy flavor. An easy, versatile, flavor-packed side dish. Vegan, Gluten-free, Paleo!
